{"message":"I’m sorry you’re dealing with this — I can help. Because multiple cards are PIN-locked we have to follow our PIN-lock investigation process, and I’ll need to verify your identity before I can access or make changes to your cards. Before we proceed, a few quick questions so I know how you want to handle this:

1) Do the four PIN‑locked cards belong to the same Rho‑Bank account? (Yes/No)
2) Do you still have all four physical cards in your possession? (Yes/No)
3) Have you noticed any unauthorized transactions on any of the linked accounts? (Yes/No — if yes, please say which card/transaction amounts/dates)
4) Do you believe your PINs were compromised or shared with anyone? (Yes/No/Not sure)

If you want me to proceed now, please confirm you’d like me to verify your identity and provide any TWO of the following (pick two):
- Date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY)
- Email on file
- Phone number on file
- Mailing address on file

Note: If any card shows a security hold or was reported lost/stolen, that card cannot be unlocked here and we’ll need to escalate to security. If you’d prefer immediate transfer to a human/security team instead of going through verification and the investigation steps here, tell me and I’ll arrange that.

What would you like to do, and which two verification fields will you provide now?"}

1) Yes.  
2) Yes, I have all four physical cards with me.  
3) No, I haven’t noticed any unauthorized transactions — they just show as PIN locked.  
4) Not sure. I haven’t shared my PINs with anyone, but something weird is clearly going on.

Yes, please proceed with identity verification. Here are two fields:  
- Date of birth: 06/18/1983  
- Phone number: 303-555-7291

Thanks — that helps. I can proceed, but to complete verification I need to look up your account record using one of our read tools. I can search by full name or by email address. Can you please provide either:

- The email address on file, or  
- Your full name (as it appears on the account)

Once you provide one of those I will look up your record, confirm the two fields you gave (DOB and phone), and then log the verification. After that I’ll proceed with the PIN‑lock investigation for each of the four cards.
